rule: Every AWS service component Render's design selectors can emit resolves to exactly one of: a priced section in the pricing file (pricing, dotted JSON path), a _no_cost_services entry (no_cost), an _absent_services entry (absent), or a topology boundary that is not an AWS resource (topology, reason required). A design aws_service joined with ' + ' is split into components. An estimate line is null in exactly two cases, each with an `exclusion_reason` and an entry in `unpriced_line_ids`: a component is absent (`no_rate`), or the quantity its rate multiplies is not established (`no_quantity`: a cron with no run history, a Workflow with no duration, Step Functions or ECR with no captured volume, or Aurora sized to a class in `_unavailable_instances`). A line whose components are all pricing, no_cost or topology and whose quantity is established must carry an amount. Never invent a quantity to avoid a null.

CI/CD immutable digest promotion.topology: A promotion procedure over the ECR image; the registry storage is the Amazon ECR component.

Amazon ECR immutable image digest.topology: A digest reference to an image already priced by the Amazon ECR component.

Selected AWS workflow orchestrator versi.topology: A version of the selected orchestrator; priced on the orchestrator line.

AWS workflow execution history.topology: Run history consumed by the selected orchestrator line.

AWS workflow retry history.topology: Retry history consumed by the selected orchestrator line.

AWS account and VPC environment strategy.topology: Account and VPC boundary; no AWS resource of its own.

AWS deployment environment stack.topology: Environment boundary for naming, state and tags; no AWS resource of its own.

selected serving endpoint.topology: The ALB, CloudFront or Beanstalk endpoint already priced on its own line.

external DNS.topology: DNS stays with the customer's provider; no AWS resource.

pg_dump and pg_restore.topology: A migration method run by the customer; no AWS resource.

logical replication.topology: A migration method run by the customer; no AWS resource.
